content.title: Fastest marathon (female) | Guinness World Records
content.text: Share Facebook Twitter Email Whatsapp Pinterest LinkedIn Reddit Contact an Account Manager Who Ruth Chepngetich What 2:09:56 hour(s):minute(s):second(s) Where United States (Chicago) When 13 October 2024 The fastest marathon (female) is 2 hours 9 min 56 sec, achieved by Ruth Chepngetich (Kenya) in Chicago, Illinois, USA, on 13 October 2024. Ruth Chepngetich became the first woman to run 26.2 miles in under 2 hours 10 minutes at the 2024 Bank of America Chicago Marathon. She took almost two minutes off the world record, and more than four minutes off her previous personal best over the distance. It was her Chepngetich’s third victory in the Chicago Marathon, also a women’s record. Records change on a daily basis and are not immediately published online.
